Landing.subtitle: Get an expert-level UX/UI audit in seconds — no consultant required. Powered by AI trained on elite design patterns and accessibility standards.
Landing.featureHierarchyDesc: Heatmap analysis reveals where user attention actually flows. We detect noise and suggest structural shifts for better conversion.
Landing.featureContrastDesc: Real-time accessibility checks for AA and AAA compliance. Automated color suggestions ensure every user can experience your vision.
Landing.featureRecommendationsDesc: Not just problems — solutions. Get specific CSS tweaks and layout adjustments to resolve friction points instantly.
Landing.ctaSectionDesc: Join over 450+ senior design leads who use Poisik to validate their interface decisions before going to code.
Landing.ctaSectionTrial: Free 7-day trial. No credit card required.
Landing.heroSubtitle: The authoritative AI auditing platform for senior designers. Precise insights, clear metrics, and sophisticated feedback for your most critical products.
Landing.heroImageAlt: Poisik audit dashboard showing a usability score and design issue breakdown
Landing.processStep1Desc: Drop your Figma frames, PNGs, or live URLs directly into the audit engine.
Landing.processStep2Desc: Our vision models analyze every pixel against established design systems and WCAG rules.
Landing.processStep3Desc: Receive a detailed report with specific action items to perfect your design's poise.
Landing.feature1Desc: Ensuring the most important information is seen first through luminance and scale.
Landing.feature2Desc: Automated WCAG 2.1 compliance checks for every color pair across your entire UI.
Landing.feature3Desc: Precision 8pt grid alignment detection to identify visual "noise" and misalignments.
Landing.feature4Desc: Auditing font-weights, line-heights, and readability for a premium reading experience.
Landing.feature5Desc: Going beyond color to check focus states, touch targets, and ARIA labels.
Landing.feature6Desc: Detecting component deviations to maintain a cohesive brand voice throughout.
Landing.differentiatorsSectionTitle: It doesn't just tell you what's wrong — it fixes it.
Landing.diffCodeDesc: Export optimized CSS and Tailwind tokens for every detected improvement.
Landing.diffUrlDesc: Paste a link and watch Poisik crawl and audit your production site in seconds.
Landing.diffCompareDesc: Benchmark your scores against industry leaders and competitor benchmarks.
Landing.finalCtaTitle: Don't take our word for it
Landing.finalCtaDesc: Experience the precision of the world's most sophisticated design auditor. Upload your first file and see the difference.
Landing.footerTagline: Auditing the world's finest digital products with absolute poise.
